summary: Fish Audio's startup program: 12 million characters per month of free TTS/audio generation for 3 months (~240+ hours of audio monthly), plus premium support with raised concurrency and model shaping help. Applications are reviewed rather than automatically awarded. The form requires full name, a field labeled Work email, company name, a valid company website and a description of what you are building. Role, team size and funding stage are optional, as is the case-study opt-in.
claim_steps: Open https://fish.audio/startup/ and select Apply to the Startup Program.
Provide full name, work email, company name, a valid company website and a description of at least 10 characters. Role, team size and funding stage are optional.
The case-study checkbox is optional. Submit only your real application and await email review; the form says the team will review it and get back to you.
